results.rationale: Consistency: the shoe silhouette, heel, beige lining, white background and shadow are retained; the lining/edge texture is slightly rougher. Instruction: the red exterior is fully changed to black while retaining the same shoe. Quality: the shoe geometry and reflections are coherent, with a minor grainy, uneven texture on the glossy upper.

Consistency: numerous original white stones change color or position, many extra stones appear, and a rectangular rock is added. Instruction: a black line is produced partly by replacing the original right-end white stone, rather than adding one legal winning black stone to the existing position. Knowledge: the wholesale board changes violate the requested single-move win. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: many tiny off-intersection stones, inconsistent piece sizes and an incongruous block create multiple structural and semantic irregularities.
